Part 2&3 事件 EVENTS

Describe a time when you got up early

描述一次你很早就起床的经历

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

Part 2 话题卡片

Describe a time when you got up early

  • When it was (是什么时候)
  • What you did (你做了什么)
  • Why you got up early (你为什么早起)
  • And how you felt about it (并谈谈你当时的感受)

问题与答案

Cue CardDescribe a time when you got up early

I'd like to describe a time when I got up really early, earlier than I ever do normally. It happened about a year ago, during the summer holidays, when I was staying at home with my family. The funny thing is, I didn't plan to get up early at all. I woke up around five in the morning, before the sun had even come up, and I just couldn't get back to sleep. I lay there for a while, but my mind was already wide awake, so eventually I gave up and got out of bed. Since there was nothing else to do at that hour, I went straight to my computer. I remember the house was completely quiet, and the sky outside was still dark. I spent the time browsing the internet, watching a few videos, and messing around with some code, which is what I usually do anyway. It felt strange to be doing my normal evening routine in the early morning. As for how I felt, it was actually a mixed experience. On one hand, I enjoyed the peace and quiet, because there were no messages, no noise, nobody asking me anything. On the other hand, I felt a bit tired later in the day, and I ended up taking a long nap in the afternoon. Looking back, I think it was a nice change of pace, even though I wouldn't want to do it every day.

我讲的是去年暑假一次特别早的早起。我根本没打算早起，早上五点左右醒来，太阳还没出来，就是睡不着，躺了一会儿干脆起床。那个点没事做，我就去开电脑，家里特别安静、窗外还黑着，我上网、看视频、写点代码，感觉像把晚上的日常搬到了清晨。感受很复杂：一方面享受安静，没人打扰；另一方面白天犯困，下午补了个长觉。偶尔一次不错，但不想天天这样。

Q2Do you know anyone who likes to get up early?

Yes, my grandfather is a good example. He gets up before sunrise every day and goes for a walk in the park, and he says it makes him feel healthy and energetic. I also have a classmate who wakes up at six to study before class, because she says the morning is the quietest time. So I do know early risers, though I have to admit I'm not one of them myself.

有，我爷爷就是。他每天日出前起床去公园散步，说这样身体舒服、精神好。我还有个同学六点起来学习，说早上最安静。我确实认识爱早起的人，不过我自己不是。

Q3Why do people get up early?

There are several reasons. Some people get up early because of work or school, since they have to commute or start their day early. Others do it for health, because morning exercise is good for the body, and the air is fresher. A more personal reason is that some people simply enjoy the quiet time before the rest of the world wakes up, which lets them focus on their own things. So it's usually a mix of necessity and preference.

原因有好几个。有人因为工作学习必须早起，要通勤或早开工；有人为了健康，晨练对身体好、空气也新鲜；还有人纯粹喜欢世界醒来前的安静，能专心做自己的事。通常是必要加偏好。

Q4What kinds of occasions need people to arrive early?

I'd say any occasion where being late would cause trouble for others. For example, exams, flights and trains all require people to arrive early, because they have fixed schedules. Job interviews and important meetings are similar, since arriving late creates a bad impression. In my country, people also arrive early for weddings and family gatherings, out of respect. So generally speaking, the more formal or time-sensitive the occasion, the earlier people should arrive.

凡是迟到会给别人添麻烦的场合都要早到。比如考试、飞机、火车都有固定时间；面试和重要会议迟到会留下坏印象。在我国，婚礼和家庭聚会也会早到以示尊重。越正式、越讲究时间的场合越该早到。

Q5Why do some people like to stay up late?

I think the main reason is that the night is the only time that truly belongs to them. During the day, students and workers have to follow other people's schedules, so they only get free time in the evening, and they don't want to waste it by sleeping. Another factor is that phones and games are designed to keep people engaged, so it's easy to lose track of time. Having said that, I think staying up late is often a habit rather than a real preference.

主要原因是夜晚才是真正属于自己的时间。白天学生和上班族都跟着别人的安排走，只有晚上有空，舍不得用来睡觉。另外手机和游戏设计得让人停不下来，很容易忘了时间。不过我觉得熬夜更多是习惯，不是真喜欢。

Q6Is it good to arrive early in any situation?

Not necessarily, I'd say. Arriving early is usually good, because it shows responsibility and gives you time to prepare. However, in some situations it can be wasteful, for example if you arrive an hour early for a meeting, you just end up waiting. There's also a social aspect, because in some cultures arriving too early for a dinner party can actually be inconvenient for the host. So on the whole, being early is safer than being late, but timing should still be sensible.

不一定。早到通常好，显得负责、有时间准备。但有些场合会浪费，比如开会早到一小时只能干等。还有社交因素，有些文化里赴宴到太早反而让主人不方便。总体早到比迟到安全，但时间也要合理。

Q7待补充

First of all, I think it has to be gradual, because suddenly waking up at five after months of sleeping late rarely works. People can start by going to bed a little earlier each night, and setting a fixed alarm even on weekends. Another useful trick is to have a reason to get up, like exercise or a hobby, because motivation makes it much easier. Having said that, I think consistency matters most, since the body eventually adapts to a regular routine.

首先得循序渐进，长期晚睡的人突然五点起很难坚持。可以每晚早睡一点，周末也定固定闹钟。另一个办法是给早起找个理由，比如锻炼或爱好，有动力就容易多了。但最重要的还是坚持，身体最终会适应规律作息。
